logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the drugs was assessed by their octanol/water partition coefficient (Log Po/w). The Log Po/w was determined using the octanol/water shake-flask method. Equal volumes of octanol and pure water were mixed and shaken for 24 h to pre-saturate the solutions. Equal volumes of the pre-treated octanol and water were then mixed, and the target compounds were added until saturation. The mixture was shaken for 48 h and centrifuged at 2500 rpm for 15 min. The Log Po/w values of the synthesized prodrugs were determined by measuring the UV absorbance of the compounds in the octanol and water phases at room temperature using a UV spectrophotometer. The log Pow was calculated using the formula (4-1), where Ao is the UV absorbance of the compound in octanol at a specific wavelength(273 nm), and Aw is the UV absorbance of the compound in the aqueous phase at the same wavelength(273 nm).
